chunks: When your children have reached the age of puberty, they should similarly ask your leave (for entering) as others did before them. God thus clearly explains His commands to you, for God is all-knowing and all-wise.
ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic etiquette for children when they reach puberty regarding entering private rooms?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this verse is often linked with the concept of 'three times of privacy' (salasil), marking the transition from childhood innocence to social accountability. It establishes a framework for modesty and respect within the family unit, emphasizing that privacy is a divine right (haqq) rather than merely a social custom. The reference to 'those before them' highlights the continuity of prophetic etiquette across generations.
